trap.label: pronome no meio
trap.wrong: They singled out it for praise.
trap.right: They singled it out for praise.
trap.why: Em português o complemento vem depois do verbo (“destacaram-no”). Em inglês, nos phrasal verbs separáveis, o pronome vai ENTRE verbo e partícula.

mcq.q: “___ for criticism” = chosen to be blamed

fix.wrong: The study singled out it as the main cost.
fix.right: The study singled it out as the main cost.

fix.wrong: Standby power was single out in the report.
fix.right: Standby power was singled out in the report.

fix.wrong: They singled out him for praise.
fix.right: They singled him out for praise.
fix.why: Pronome pessoal entre o verbo e out.

rewrite.prompt: Substitua o objeto por it: “The report singled out the heating share.”
Passiva: “The report singled out appliance use.”
rewrite.answer: Appliance use was singled out in the report.

rewrite.prompt: Substitua por him: “The boss singled out Pedro for praise.”
rewrite.answer: The boss singled him out for praise.
